draft.to: Bluepeak Health (Commercial), Prior Authorization / Formulary Exceptions
draft.subject: CASE-1102: Formulary exception for Humira (brand), response to NF-PREF pend of 2026-10-15
draft.body:
Re: PT-64218, Humira (adalimumab) 40 mg q2w for rheumatoid arthritis (M06.9). Prescriber: Dr. Omar Haddad, Rheumatology, Northgate Arthritis Clinic.

We request a formulary exception under policy BP-SPX-0415, criterion 4. The attached provider chart notes document the trial and intolerance of preferred adalimumab-adaz:
- Adalimumab-adaz 40 mg q2w, 10/2024 to 01/2025.
- 11/2024: injection-site reactions with each dose.
- 01/06/2025: generalized urticaria after the 6th dose. Prescriber assessment: intolerance, likely excipient-related; discontinued.
- 02/2025: started citrate-free Humira, tolerating well. 08/2026: DAS28 2.6.

Step therapy: methotrexate 20 mg/week, 02/2024 to 08/2024, with inadequate response (DAS28 5.4).

Attachments: PA request form (received 2026-10-09); chart notes (received 2026-10-09).

Please approve Humira brand for 12 months. Thank you.
